stem: Workers repeatedly climb a ladder to reset a device that could be relocated to service height. Which long-term control best follows the course improvement model?
choices: Post a ladder reminder beside the device
Require a second worker for every reset
Track how fast each worker completes the reset
Relocate the service point so the recurring ladder exposure is eliminated or reduced
rationale: Redesigning the system to remove recurring elevated access addresses the exposure at its source rather than adding worker-dependent reminders.
